data.name: Yugank
data.gender_notes: Yugank is used as a male name in Hindu naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Embodiment of Dharma (righteousness) and Yuga (age). A name signifying the responsibility to uphold righteousness during a particular age or era. The name Yugank carries the meaning “Dharma, Yuga (Age)” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Sanskrit tradition and is also used in Hindi, Sanskrit, Marathi. Parents who choose Yugank usually hope their child will grow to embody dharma, yuga (age) and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: Bearer of Dharma in the current age.
data.etymology: Yugank belongs to the Sanskrit linguistic tradition and is used in Hindu naming. Its recorded meaning is “Dharma, Yuga (Age).”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Yugank total 7, giving a life-path number of 7. Number 7 is linked with Ketu and with the qualities of reflection, wisdom and inner depth.

data.cultural_impact: The name "Yugank" is rooted in Hindu culture, which adds a sense of pride and tradition to its bearer. It is a name that echoes through history and carries the weight of inherent duties and responsibilities. It is a reminder of one's role in society and the importance of upholding righteousness and dharma during the current age or era.
data.spiritual_significance: The name "Yugank" holds significant spiritual significance as it symbolizes the embodiment of Dharma and the current age. It indicates an understanding of the philosophical concept of dharma, the eternal law that governs the universe and the individual's responsibility to live in accordance with it. Through this name, an individual is reminding of their spiritual connection to the cosmic order and the importance of maintaining balance and righteousness. This name offers a deep sense of purpose, a reminder of one's role in the grand scheme of things.
data.spiritual_symbolism: Yugank: One who brings a new yuga or age, embodying the divine will for transformation and change. Symbolizes the embodiment of time, progress, and renewal.

vedic_reference.note: The name Yugank is derived from the Sanskrit words 'yuga' meaning age, era, and 'ank' meaning symbol of a cycle. In Hindu mythology, a yuga is a cycle of time, and is often referred to as the 'age of the gods'. The name Yugank can be seen as a symbol of continuity and the cyclical nature of time.

historical_references.reference: The Hindu scripture 'Mahabharata' mentions a king named Yugank, who was a great warrior and the king of the 'Yadava' clan. He participated in the great battle of Kurukshetra during the Mahabharata war and was a close ally of the Pandava prince Arjuna.

Another historical reference to King Yugank can be found in the 'Harivamsa Purana', an ancient Hindu text which provides an account of the life and deeds of the god Vishnu. In this text, Yugank is mentioned as the son of the king Sahasrabahu and the queen Prabha, and is described as an ideal king who ruled justly and upheld the principles of dharma.

Lastly, on Stack Overflow, 'Yugank' can be seen as a handle for a knowledgeable and solution-oriented individual in the realm of programming and software development.
